about: Story mode's bottles (docs/loop/items/I-053/spec.md section 5): the codex substance each pack item supplies to a discovered spell. Air supplies its gases free. In the block world a cast of a discovered spell needs a bottle of every reactant and uses up one of each item marked consumed; free play (the Chemistry Bench page) has unlimited bottles.

items.why: the valley's iron ore is haematite, Fe2O3
a flask of oxygen; a cast takes a little
a balloon of hydrogen; a cast takes a little
